verdict.rationale: The only evidence of a stagewise CLI is a community comment saying sign-up was possible only via the CLI. That implies an official CLI exists, but its scope is undocumented. Current first-party docs describe stagewise as a standalone desktop IDE and never document a CLI. Missing for 10: first-party CLI documentation, a command reference, evidence of CLI-driven agent workflows, and hands-on corroboration of CLI capabilities beyond sign-up.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: You can't sign up except via the CLI.
